title: Differentiable FEM versus PINN for pavement layer inverse analysis: enforcing physics as hard or soft constraints
abstract: arXiv:2606.03210v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic-differentiation-based inverse analysis methods, including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and differentiable programming, have recently shown great promise due to their ability to compute accurate gradients and convergence efficiency. However, their applicability to falling weight deflectometer (FWD) backcalculation remains unexplored. This study critically evaluates PINN-based inverse analysis for a multilayer pavement system and investigates differentiable finite element method (DiffFEM) as an alternative based on a synthetic benchmark. The standard PINN does not recover layer moduli because of the sharp domain discontinuities inherent to layered pavement systems. Although we use an extended PINN with domain decomposition (XPINN), which shows better performance on discontinuous domains, its performance remains highly sensitive to loss weighting and network architecture, and degrades under measurement noise.

translated_title: 可微分有限元法与物理信息神经网络在路面层反演分析中的对比：将物理规律作为硬约束或软约束
translated_abstract: 基于自动微分的反演分析方法，包括物理信息神经网络（PINNs）和可微分编程，因其能够计算精确梯度且收敛效率高，近年来展现出巨大前景。然而，它们在落锤式弯沉仪（FWD）反演计算中的适用性尚未被探索。本研究基于合成基准测试，批判性评估了基于PINN的多层路面系统反演分析，并研究了可微分有限元法（DiffFEM）作为替代方案。由于层状路面系统固有的尖锐域不连续性，标准PINN无法恢复层模量。尽管我们采用了具有域分解的扩展PINN（XPINN），其在非连续域上表现出更好的性能，但其性能对损失权重和网络架构仍然高度敏感，并且在测量噪声下性能会退化。
tldr: 本研究对比了PINN与可微分有限元法（DiffFEM）在路面层FWD反演中的表现，发现标准PINN因层状介质域不连续性而失效，XPINN虽有改善但对损失权重、网络架构和噪声高度敏感，表明以硬约束方式嵌入物理规律的可微分FEM是更可靠的反演方案。
en_tdlr: This study critically compares PINN-based and differentiable FEM approaches for FWD backcalculation of pavement layer moduli, showing that standard PINNs fail due to sharp domain discontinuities while XPINN remains sensitive to loss weighting, architecture, and noise, favoring physics enforced as hard constraints via differentiable FEM.
